scope: Sanitized actual source, fixture, browser, installation, native execution and service-preservation observations. Publication identity and CI are determined by the containing Git commit and its actual checks.

orchestrator_full_tree.algorithm: SHA-256 of recursively key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON file descriptors: sha256, bytes, mode; transient caches excluded

service_source_closure.algorithm: SHA-256 of recursively key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON file descriptors: sha256, bytes, mode; dependencies, build output and local state excluded

release_source_review.packaging_scope: Source collection includes required helpers, optional baselines, controller wrapper and release/migration; final archive CRC/hash inspection is separate.

instruction_forward_comparison.method: One common illustrative output per raw request assessed against both frozen instruction variants, with separate source-fit, authority, context and closure judgments. This is source review, not twelve model executions or proof of the full factory-to-original-result path.

browser_and_interaction.actual_medium: Built web UI and local backend with synthetic paginated native-history/catalog and isolated product/installed-source fixtures; no real model or private chat access in these browser tests.

fresh_optional_update_flow.scope: Actual preview/apply/verify/rollback of temporary fixture installed sources; no real host update by browser QA.

browser_and_interaction.source_continuity: The 63-check run retains its original source pins. Later controller-presentation and optional-rollback changes have separate 9-check and 7-check observations; the old full-journey result is not rebound to changed bytes. Later pagination and typed-role/context corrections have separate 7-check and 11-check built-UI observations. Actual final live screens are separately retained privately.

craft_review.scope: Three UI corrections reviewed against the accepted operational-workbench identity. Browser counts do not certify all creative qualities.

first_bounded_attempt.diagnosis: A shell here-document attempted scratch creation outside approved writable paths; exact requested outputs were not produced.

native_observations.repair_scope: General runtime guidance now confines shell temporary files to already approved writable paths or uses temporary-file-free commands; no model, permission or account setting was changed.

second_bounded_attempt.limitations: One integrated synthetic Ukrainian text/data task with five hypothetical routing cases. Actual factory construction, generated-agent installation/delegation, real product acceptance, device and WORK outcomes were not executed by this smoke.
second_bounded_attempt.source_continuity: This execution and semantic observation retains its original 64 input pins and exact installed Orchestrator1.1.0. Later read-only native-history, pagination, correlation and UI corrections have separate tests/actual native read-back; this earlier model proof is not rebound to their newer bytes.

global_native_portfolio.limitations: Available local native index only. Empty historical responses and a bounded-protocol disconnect remain explicit incomplete coverage. Record counts include separately typed system permission reviews; no product acceptance or global native-writer ownership is inferred.

read_only_history_boundary.native_index_reader: public-read-method allowlist; no resume/start/turn/mutation/credential refresh or rollout repair
read_only_history_boundary.existing_native_chat_continuation: refused when the isolated executor cannot restore persisted paginated context; use a fresh source-bound task or the capable native host
read_only_history_boundary.actual_guardian_role_probe: 7/7 pass; exact native role markers and parent/source preserved, no title/content heuristic

requirement_status_interpretation.REQ-037_to_REQ-040_implemented: Code and instructions exist. This source status does not establish every runtime, generated-agent, creative or owner-acceptance criterion.

not_claimed: An agent was created, installed, discovered and used to complete its original task in this release proof
Universal creative quality or absence of all future regressions

publication.identity: The Git commit containing this record; exact remote revision and CI result are recorded in the task closeout and visible on GitHub. This source record cannot pre-certify its future CI.

evidence_retention: Raw receipts, account/project inventories, native identifiers, outputs, screenshots and full source manifests remain private. Only this reviewed aggregate and reusable source bindings belong in the distribution.
external_completion_receipts: Archive hashes/CRC/inventories are in each build artifact BUILD.json and SHA256SUMS, outside the source to avoid recursive hashes.
Actual publication/ref/CI observations belong to the containing commit checks and private task closeout; this source record cannot pre-certify future CI.
